purpose: Attribute the accepted L13 D decode diagnostic without new model requests, new profiling or a service change. Separate three hypotheses before choosing any optimization: Graph-drain effects, CPU metadata preparation, and MC2 distributed MoE kernel time.

basis.remaining_gap: D decode remains the largest measured gap; the L13 diagnostic established span/API/kernel context but did not attribute cause.

questions.question: How much of the observed H2D/synchronization wait may be draining earlier asynchronous Graph work rather than an unnecessary copy or a safe task-queue change?
questions.needed_context: Existing operator_details.csv timestamp/row context and the exact decode step/Graph source path. Host VERIFY time is asynchronous enqueue and cannot be called device execution time.

questions.question: Which host-side speculative preparation work is CPU metadata preparation, and which spans only enqueue device work?
questions.needed_context: Exact installed eagle_worker_v2.py, eagle_worker_common.py, spec_utils.py, eagle_info_v2.py, eagle_utils.py and forward_batch_info.py byte copies, plus representative host operator rows.

questions.question: What do the per-rank MC2 MoeDistributeDispatch/Combine name buckets represent relative to other communication and kernel intervals?
questions.needed_context: Representative kernel_details.csv rows and task_time.csv interval groups. The frozen COMM regex excludes MC2, so the existing COMM bucket is not total communication time.

intended_evidence.other_rank_traces: Not read; the remaining 30 ranks are not inspected by the context collector.
intended_evidence.other_source_hashes: Recorded actuals only; no expected value is guessed.

evidence_rules: Read only the existing trace on nodes 36 and 41, sequentially, with at most one SSH session at a time.
No HTTP request, no NPU call, no SDK initialization and no model import.
Reject symlinks and paths outside the frozen profile root and source root.
Require CSV bytes and SHA256 to match the accepted evidence index and require stable mtime during the read.
Preserve all source columns; cap a single cell at 8,192 characters and mark truncation explicitly.
Do not infer timestamp units or clock bases and do not invent a cross-file join.
No Graph name guessing; kernel classes are the two MC2 MoE names plus the frozen COMM regex only.
Selected rows are a bounded sample and cannot support a full-phase attribution or a physical-utilization percentage.
forbidden_changes: No model, source, config or service reload.
No new profiling or model requests.
No SDK, driver or system change.
No precision, concurrency, MemCache or admission change.
No optimization dispatch until the existing-trace evidence is sufficient and separately reviewed.

specific_limitations: Native operator_details.csv contains duration aggregates and no timestamp, so it cannot establish which stage contains a long host memcpy or whether that wait drains earlier Graph device work.
Kernel/task CSV timestamps alone cannot be joined to missing host timestamps; no inferred join or guessed critical path is accepted.
The missing eagle_info_v2.py path was a collector source-path assumption error; the actual installed imports resolve sglang.srt.speculative.eagle_info.
Five source copies and both ranks' CSV bytes are valid partial evidence, but they do not by themselves attribute cause.
closure.source_based_lead_only: prepare_for_draft_extend calls attention metadata initialization before eager padding; its NPU path does not mark metadata ready, and the eager runner may initialize it again after padding. This is a hypothesis requiring exact runner/backend and timeline review, not an accepted redundant-work or speedup claim.
